The '''Inferno''' is a solo [[minigame]] that was added to ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' on the [[1 June]] [[2017]], along with an update to the city of [[Mor Ul Rek]]. The player must survive 69 increasingly challenging waves, ultimately killing the level 1400 [[TzKal-Zuk]], to obtain the [[infernal cape]]. If defeated, the player must restart from the first wave. A successor to the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]]s, the Inferno was dubbed the greatest solo [[PVM]] challenge to date upon release.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/the-inferno?oldschool=1|title=The Inferno|newsdate=1 June 2017|quote=The Inferno is the greatest solo PvM challenge ever to be introduced into Old School RuneScape. Beyond sacrificing a Fire Cape, there are '''no requirements''' to attempt The Inferno.}}

In order to access the Inferno, players must give [[TzHaar-Ket-Keh]] a [[fire cape]]. This is a one-time fee, so after giving a fire cape to him, TzHaar-Ket-Keh will allow players to enter as much as they want. Restocking between waves is not possible and other players cannot enter, although the minigame can be paused by attempting to log out between waves. [[Purple sweet]]s also cannot be used in the Inferno.

If the player has previously defeated TzKal-Zuk, it may be chosen as a Slayer task when assigned TzHaar, which will affect all monsters inside the Inferno. The task will also be cancelled in the event the player is defeated, much like the [[TzHaar Fight Cave|Fight Caves]].

In 2018, the Inferno was made inaccessible on [[unrestricted world]]s to prevent players from practising an unlimited amount of times without supply costs.{{CiteTwitter|author=Old School RuneScape|url=https://twitter.com/OldSchoolRS/status/972057245658832896|date=9 March 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105944|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=We have now restricted access to The Inferno within the Beta worlds. This is to restrict free practicing.}} However, this decision appears to have been reversed since 2021, with nearly all unrestricted worlds since the [[Unrestricted world#Equipment Rebalancing Beta|Equipment Rebalancing Beta]] allowing players access to it.
